title: Leakage-Audited Solar Flare Forecasting Across Solar Cycles 24 and 25: code and result tables
description: Reproducible Colab notebook, result tables and figures for M+ solar flare forecasting (24 h horizon) from SDO/HMI SHARP parameters, comparing random, active-region-grouped and forward-in-time evaluation and transfer between Solar Cycles 24 and 25.
